stock_merger_audit.correction: The stock merger correctly read the 17 isolated files but its infer_source implementation has a Scopus branch and no IEEE Xplore branch. All 110 IEEE raw events were labeled `unknown`; this second pass restores IEEE Xplore from the fixed source-prefixed input inventory and preserves source records/provenance.

identity_rules_in_order: normalized DOI: resolver/prefix removed, lower-case, terminal punctuation removed
same-source stable paperId: only within the same named source
manually confirmed normalized title + year: explicit whitelist only; zero new edges were needed in this run
manually confirmed title-only fallback: explicit whitelist only; zero edges used in this run

manual_title_matching_audit.decision: No unlinked normalized title+year pair remained after DOI and same-source paperId matching, and no title-only cross-year collision existed. Therefore no title-based edge was needed or silently applied.

near_title_nonmerge_check.reason: Highly similar CubeSat MBSE reference-model interim-status titles are explicitly numbered and separately dated/DOI-identified reports (#/year variants), so title similarity is not bibliographically safe identity evidence.

metadata_preference_rules.record_preference: Prefer richer supplied metadata (authors, then abstract length, then publication type/venue, then DOI); at a tie prefer IEEE Xplore because the corresponding Scopus rows are known to lack abstracts/authors, then fixed input order and source rank.
metadata_preference_rules.title: Prefer a mixed-case title variant; otherwise prefer the selected rich record/longest title.
metadata_preference_rules.authors: Prefer the nonempty list with most supplied names.
metadata_preference_rules.abstract: Prefer the longest nonempty supplied abstract; truncation remains flagged rather than silently treated as complete.
metadata_preference_rules.year: Use modal nonempty source year; tie resolves to selected rich record.
metadata_preference_rules.citationCount: Use the maximum supplied source snapshot and retain conflicting snapshots in provenance/metadata_conflicts.
metadata_preference_rules.doi: Use normalized DOI from the selected rich record; retain all source variants in provenance/metadata_conflicts.
metadata_preference_rules.openAccess_pdf_url: Use a supplied open-access PDF URL only; publisher landing pages are kept separately and are not called open access.
